text:
molly: Anyone watching eu-central mTLS error graphs? spike at 2025-01-14T11:12:30Z. TLS handshakes failing with verify errors and short cert chains.
dean: I'm on it. Initial glance: rotator reported 'issued cert' but proxies logged 'handshake: no certificate presented' intermittently.
chao: Correlating with KMS logs now. I see a cluster of KMS PermissionDenied for principal `service/rotator-eu@redwood` at 2025-01-14T11:11:22Z. Looks like an RBAC change landed in the last deploy.
molly: That would explain it if rotator couldn't unwrap the signing key. Were edge proxies rolled during that time?
dean: Yes, an infra deploy went out at 11:10:00Z. The terraform diff removed a binding on a shared KMS key for several service accounts; it included rotator-eu. Might have been an accidental scope tighten.
chao: KMS shows UnwrapDenied errors ~11:11:20 -> 11:13:00Z. rotator logs show issuance events but subsequent 'unwrap failed' and 'chain push skipped'. Here's the snippet: 
```
2025-01-14T11:11:21Z rotator-eu rotator: INFO issued cert id=abc123
2025-01-14T11:11:21Z rotator-eu rotator: ERROR unwrap failed: permissions denied (KMS UnwrapDenied)
2025-01-14T11:11:22Z rotator-eu rotator: WARN chain_push: aborted
```
molly: Ops plan: patch IAM to re-add kms:Decrypt for rotator-eu -> restart rotator -> force edge proxy eviction. Which is fastest?
dean: Patch IAM then restart rotator. I can do the IAM quick patch via console; terraform roll-forward will follow.
chao: While Dean patches, can we add a short-term mitigation: configure ingress to fallback to older certs if new chain not available? Might reduce failures while we fix.
molly: Good idea but need to be careful about producing invalid certs. Let's avoid automated fallback unless the chain is valid. Better: reduce cert cache TTL at proxies to accelerate replacement once rotator is fixed.
ops-bot: Deploy notice: rollouts happening in eu-central: rotator (infra), edge-proxy (ingress) queued.
dean: IAM change applied. KMS audit shows Allow for rotator-eu now.
chao: Triggering rotator restart: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator --region=eu-central`
ops-bot: Restart triggered for rotator-eu - pods will sequentially restart.
dean: Rotator logs after restart: successful unwrap + chain_pushed events appearing. Pushing rollout for edge proxies to clear cert caches: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy --region=eu-central`
molly: Observability: handshake error rate dropped from 9.1% -> 0.9% over 8 minutes. Still seeing a tail of fails from older proxies.
chao: Noted root cause: RBAC / terraform change removed KMS unwrap permission for rotator principal in eu-central. Secondary: long cert cache TTL on some legacy proxies prolonged the incident.
dean: Immediate action items I just did: 1) re-add KMS decrypt to rotator-eu, 2) restart rotator, 3) restart edge-proxies.
molly: Post-incident actions: - Add a terraform pre-apply hook that warns when a KMS key binding for principals with tag 'rotator' or 'cert-issuer' is removed (block by default). - Add an alert: KMS UnwrapDenied spike -> page sec-oncall. - Decrease cert cache TTL during rotation windows (default 5m). - Correlate TF change IDs with KMS audit events in the console for faster triage.
chao: Also propose: rotator should emit a 'chain_unwrap_ok' metric and an 'issuance_incomplete' counter when issuance events occur without unwrap success. Alert when issuance_incomplete > 5 in 1m.
molly: Agreed. I'll file the JIRA.
jira-bot: Created SEC-10432: "RBAC removal blocked KMS unwrap -> mTLS handshake failures (eu-central)." https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-10432
dean: Closing the oncall thread. If anything else pops up, ping here. :thumbsup:
